# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-05T17:48Z · next run ~23:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-06T07:48Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 26 measured from open data, 10 follow a published figure, 53 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 38/100 (Unsettled) · 16 Alert · 38 Watch · 35 Normal Headline: Chip stocks drag the S&P 500 down over 3% on 5 Nov; tankers are hit again in a largely shut Hormuz as US–Iran talks stall; the Bank of England raises rates to 4%.
## Situations (8 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: Tankers hit in Hormuz on 5 Nov; Tehran contacts Gulf states amid fears of US strikes. Brent rebounds to about $97. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, oil, eu-gas, fertiliser, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, worsening]: Russian strikes keep hitting Ukraine's grid; an aid-centre strike on 3 Nov was among the deadliest. Talks set for 10–11 Nov. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI rose to +2.5 for Aug–Oct: drought risk in East and southern Africa, record-range warmth and faster CO₂ growth. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: ECDC counted 10,274 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,992 deaths in DR Congo to 28 Oct; imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria; a WHO PHEIC since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: UN warns of deadly drone strikes on Sudan's grid and civilians; a South Kordofan fuel-station strike killed at least 7 on 4 Nov. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread near 160bp; nationwide strike on 5 Nov with largely peaceful marches; budget deadline 17 Nov. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: Bank of England raised Bank Rate to 4% on 5 Nov and warned inflation will near 5%; US CPI 4.0%; RBA hiked on 3 Nov. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility, gilts; normal: em-stress - Binance theft and North Korean escalation [WATCH, worsening]: FBI blames North Korea for a $6.3bn Binance theft; Pyongyang denied it and fired several missiles on 4 Nov. Binance withdrawals have resumed. → watch: cyber, korea
## Other Alerts - Global food prices [food-prices] stable: FAO food price index 136.0 in September, above the 135 Alert line; October due 6 Nov - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable: UK national threat level Severe: an attack is highly likely
